title: HBO Max's verified Reddit account (u/hbomax) was compromised and used to publish 108 ClickFix ads over 48 hours targeting Windows and macOS.
content_md:
HBO Max's verified Reddit account (u/hbomax) was compromised and used to publish 108 ClickFix ads over 48 hours targeting Windows and macOS.

via Mastodon https://cyberworldops.eu/en/hijacked-hbo-max-reddit-account-pushed-108-clickfix-malware-ads
